definition: NCBI assigned_molecule_location_type for a closed replicon; the occurrence's coordinates fall inside that molecule.
basis: documentation, not prediction; 0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous, 0 missing
what_it_establishes: That a gene IS on a chromosome or a plasmid.
what_it_does_not_establish: Nothing about whether it can move.

definition: A profile-homology hit to an IS/transposase or integrase/integron marker within the occurrence's own +/-10 kb window. This is what portability_class B means.
basis: protein-profile homology; blinded expert agreement 0.9920 (CI 0.9761-1.0000) for MOBILE versus QUIESCENT on 120 stratified blocks
what_it_establishes: That a mobile-element marker is NEARBY.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not that an intact element is present, and not that it is or ever was active.

definition: A complete insertion sequence — complete transposase ORF plus bilateral resolved terminal inverted repeats — FULLY CONTAINED within the occurrence's own +/-10 kb window. ISEScan 1.7.3 under a pinned environment.
basis: structural reconstruction over a 21,955-block census, 0 tool failures, 35 independent verification checks with 0 disagreements
what_it_establishes: That a complete element IS THERE, resolved end to end. 12,034 of 35,140 chromosomal occurrences; 12,032 of those are class B (73.80 % corroboration).
what_it_does_not_establish: Not transposition, not excision, not transfer. A structure is not an event.

definition: MOB-suite relaxase / MPF / oriT marker detection defining classes C, D and E, with E2 the nested subset additionally carrying oriT.
basis: marker databases; 0.0000 % class transitions across tool and database version; independent corroboration by CONJScan at kappa 0.875 on the class E definition
what_it_establishes: That machinery CONSISTENT WITH mobilization or conjugation is encoded.
what_it_does_not_establish: Not that conjugation occurred, or could occur in any given host. Absence of a marker is a statement about the database.

definition: A mating, transposition, excision or transfer assay.
basis: NONE — no such experiment exists anywhere in this study
what_it_does_not_establish: Every claim of demonstrated transfer, active transposition, observed horizontal gene transfer, mobilization or co-selection is PROHIBITED on this dataset.
